displayName: Find Me — searcher stuck on selfie upload

documentation.content:
A Find Me searcher had their selfie refused several times in a row and was shown the admin@mmrunners.org escape hatch. The log entry's jsonPayload carries `context.streak` (how many consecutive rejections), `context.reasons` (the refusal codes — e.g. multiple_faces, no_face, too_blurry), `context.eventId`, plus `uid` and `by` (email, absent for guests).

This fires from the SAME /api/client-errors path as browser crashes, so it also matches the general error-alert policy. Filter on `jsonPayload.kind="selfie_stuck"` (as below) to route it separately — it is a usability signal, not an outage: someone is about to give up on finding their photos. Reasons that repeat across users point at a real problem (a detector regression, or wording that isn't landing); reasons that vary usually mean one person with an awkward photo.

conditions.displayName: Repeated selfie rejections reported by the web client

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="event-photo-api" AND jsonPayload.clientError=true AND jsonPayload.kind="selfie_stuck"
